newsitem.title: FINLAND: Outokumpu warns of weaker 1996 profits.
newsitem.headline: Outokumpu warns of weaker 1996 profits.

text.p: Finnish metals and mining group Outokumpu Oy said in a statement on Monday its May-August result would be clearly weaker than in January-April and that its 1996 result would be significantly weaker than in 1995.

It cited a 150 million markka ($33.5 million) copper products inventory loss, declining prices of stainless steel and copper and said it would write down its mine property by 150 million markka in the May-August due to a down-scaling of its Forrestania nickel mine in Australia.

Outokumpu posted a 305 million markka profit before extraordinary items in January-April, down from 789 million a year earlier. Its full-year 1995 profit before extraordinary items was 1.48 billion markka.
"The result of the Outokumpu Group for the second tertial of the year will be clearly weaker than for the fist tertial," Outokumpu said.

"Although the financial development is expected to improve somewhat during the rest of the year, the Group's result for the whole of 1996 will, in the light of the current outlook, be significantly weaker than the previous year," it said. ($ = 4.478 Finnish Markka)
